rationale: The original short thesis relied on price trading below the 5-minute 9-EMA, which has now been violated as TSM bounced from a low near $363.32 (0.60% MFE) back to $365.13, reclaiming the 9-EMA ($364.78). The most recent five 1-minute candles show a clear progression of higher lows and higher highs from $363.50 to $365.13, erasing nearly the entire unrealized gain. Exiting now preserves the remaining small profit rather than holding against shifting short-term momentum into the final hour of a strongly bullish broader market (SPY +4.75%).
